name: odu
//workspaces: Each member is a WALL, not a folder, and the walls run ONE WAY: cli → execution → run-history → run-client. run-client is the half of odu a client of a LIVE run holds; run-history is everything that OUTLIVES a coordinator (the per-user catalog, the journal, per-attempt evidence, and the checkout-scoped ledger as its legacy half); execution is everything that DOES a run; cli is the two ways of WATCHING one (the native CLI/TUI and the MCP surface). What is left in src/ is the composition roots — main.ts and runner-main.ts — the only place the faces and the engine are wired to each other. Each member's src/closure.test.ts walks its own import graph, so the direction is physics rather than discipline. Every member is also listed in `dependencies` below: the isolated linker symlinks only the root package's DIRECT dependencies into the root node_modules, so without those entries `@odu/*` would not resolve from src/.
//overrides: One effect instance, always. The @kolu/* sources are hydrated from the Nix store and resolve `effect` by walking up to this root node_modules (bunfig.toml explains the isolated-linker invariant), so a second copy arriving transitively would give kolu's _tag-based error narrowing two class realms to disagree about.
